info.description: Loopback Runtime: local templates, Navigator operations and explicitly authorized browser-session BYOK.

post.description: 同一Origin・期待Hostを検証。bodyは正確に{}。202は受付のみ、CLIはOS lock解放まで待つ。
One OS-user owner, resolved by the loopback host. Exact Host and same Origin required; JSON cannot supply an owner or grant. Body limit 90 MiB. No API key.

post.description: Exact Host required. Mutations require same Origin; GET also accepts Sec-Fetch-Site:same-origin when Origin is absent. Body limit 8 KiB, or 64 KiB for invoke. no-store. API key in Runtime memory only. One-hour idle session cookie. Status does not renew. test-preview creates a fixed connection-check interaction with zero sends. invoke accepts only 1.1.0 interaction operations and binds them to this provider's Cookie; authorize_send ALLOW consumes one preview, retry requires fresh permission. Normal /invoke has no browser credentials.
